MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Lead With Your Heart appeals to me because its vocal harmonies connect with what I enjoyed about The New Old Fashioned, and it suits my less seasonal mood today.",
    "Come Darkness Come Light: Twelve Songs of Christmas fits my repeated Christmas listening, even though I would save it for another visit."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Faith-focused, devotional, and gospel albums miss what I want today; enjoying Christmas albums does not mean I am seeking religious music.",
    "Traditional country hits and older rock-and-roll collections do not offer the group vocal harmonies I am interested in right now.",
    "I cannot connect Anthology or Bonus Tracks to my interests because I do not know enough about the music to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Christmas listening seems to have been taken as a broader interest in devotional and gospel recordings.",
    "The country selections seem to stretch my interest in The New Old Fashioned beyond the vocal harmonies that appeal to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent listening points toward wanting group vocal harmonies outside a Christmas setting.",
    "My Christmas interactions happened close together during one holiday period, so they do not necessarily describe what I want on every visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in vocal harmonies and Christmas music, but extend that too broadly into country and religious listening."
}
